reader_a.answer: 1. Finish the Animals action, including moving the Animals card to slot 1, before taking an animal-granted named action. Use that Action card normally and move it to slot 1 after the granted action. 2. A named action cannot be replaced with the X-token alternative. Determination grants any action and may choose the X-token alternative.
reader_a.evidence: Base animal ability clarifications: Action / Determination.

reader_b.answer: 1. Finish the Animals action, including moving its card to slot 1, before taking a granted action. Then use the named Action card normally and move it to slot 1 after that action. 2. A named action, such as Sponsors, cannot be replaced with the X-token action. 3. Determination (Any Action) may choose any action, including the X-token alternative.
reader_b.evidence: Base animal ability clarifications: Action/Determination timing, card movement and X-token alternative distinction.

reason: A timing clause explicitly limits itself to named action; Determination supplies choice only. B shared before-taking-a-granted-action timing covers both. Meaningful normal card-use shorthand is accepted; no other answer is borrowed.
